title: Broncos WR Pat Bryant has been designated to return from the IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos WR Pat Bryant has been designated to return from the IR
sources.description: According to multiple reports, the Denver Broncos have designated wide receiver Pat Bryant to return from the injured reserve. The Broncos’ second-year wide receiver was back at practice today after suffering an ankle injury during the team’s loss to the 49ers and has been sidelined for the past four games.
